status: frozen before E0/E1 computation; exploratory PolypGen audit
scope: Offline E0 and E1 only. No new predictions, training, E2 or propagation execution authorized.

E0.sources: Checksum-verified archived SAM2 and SAMURAI predictions; original manifest GT
E0.unit: Sequence; report arithmetic means of per-sequence means, not pooled frames
partition_priority: empty prediction: all deficit is complete_miss
otherwise errors inside symmetric GT boundary band: edge
E0.band: Boundary IoU unchanged mask_to_boundary(GT,0.02), then OpenCV rectangular dilation with radius round(0.02*image_diagonal). Operational contour tolerance band, not an anatomical classification. At clipped image borders it is truncated.
E0.disjoint_nonempty_predictions: Report separately as zero-overlap; do not label them empty predictions
E0.timing: Ordered sampled-frame offsets and source-index gaps. >6 after prompt is descriptive, NOT beyond native memory. Prompt remains conditioning memory.
E0.appearance: Report adjacent GT area log-ratio and normalized centroid displacement as geometry proxies only; not semantic appearance or physical elapsed time.

screening.interpretation: Pragmatic prospective exploratory screen for longer-history investigation, not evidence that longer memory works. Both conditions must hold in native SAM2. No E2+ is automatically launched.

E1.source: Saved native 256x256 logits and mixed_cells labels; verify against recomputed pinned author occupancy. Never use PNG round-trip or GT to select tokens.
E1.partition: Existing BG/FG-interior/mixed-boundary labels unchanged. Split BG into near/far using Efficient-SAM2 dilate_mask(kernel_size=3) on object-occupied 64x64 cells. Near ring is one Chebyshev token outward, clipped at image border.
E1.retention: Older frames retain interior + boundary + near background. This clarifies interior plus ring: boundary is retained, not silently dropped. Far background omitted for this budget audit only.
E1.capacity: Report counts and floor(20480/m) for m>0 as hypothetical repeated-frame capacity. Also simulate actual prior-frame counts: from each next target retain most recent older frames until budget exhausted, excluding prompt and latest; zero-cost empty frames allowed only within finite observed history.
E1.limits: Attention spatial-key budget only, not total stored memory or compute. Pointer keys additional and untouched. No fixed global K is justified by mean occupancy alone. Archived native trajectories are not sparse-propagation trajectories.

sources.attribution: Author morphology and occupancy reused unchanged. Error taxonomy, budget arithmetic, screening criteria and archive integration are project-specific experiment glue, not published author algorithms. Mixed-region interpretation follows BPR/Mask Transfiner; Efficient-SAM2 itself does not define a boundary class.
